main.description: Lists indexed attachments. Repeated unbracketed array keys accept at most 100 values each; values within each filter use OR, distinct filters use AND, and duplicate inputs are removed. subjects matches any record.subjects[].uri without CID comparison; contentTypes is an exact open-string match. Results sort by (createdAt, uri), default desc, with an opaque cursor bound to sortDirection; input URI order is not preserved. The full record and hydrated publisher actor are returned; related targets and file bytes are not fetched. Missing author records are null, while operational hydration failures return errors. Authentication is not required.

authors.description: Publisher repository DIDs; OR within this filter.

uris.description: Exact attachment AT-URIs for bounded batch hydration; OR within this filter.

subjects.description: Subject AT-URIs matched against any record.subjects[].uri, regardless of position and without CID comparison; OR within this filter.

contentTypes.description: Exact open-string matches against record.contentType; this is not a file MIME-type filter.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for (createdAt, uri); default desc.

limit.description: Maximum attachments in the page; default 25.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor bound to sortDirection; keep other parameters unchanged between pages.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A filter value, sort direction, page bound, cursor, repeated scalar, or query parameter is invalid.

errors.name: AttachmentQueryFailed
errors.description: The attachment query or required publisher hydration failed; retry after checking the HappyView PostgreSQL service.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when there is no next page.
